field.name: economic_nexus_threshold
field.comment: IN economic nexus gross receipts threshold: $100,000 (transaction threshold removed Jan 1, 2024)

field.name: transaction_threshold
field.comment: IN transaction threshold eliminated as of January 1, 2024 (previously 200)

field.name: apportionment_formula
field.comment: IN uses single-sales factor apportionment (100% sales factor)

field.name: state_tax_rate
field.comment: IN corporate income tax rate: 4.9% flat rate (2025) - Indiana Code § 6-3-2-1

field.name: state_additions
field.comment: IN additions: out-of-state municipal bond interest (acquired after 12/31/2011), certain expenses, etc.

field.name: state_subtractions
field.comment: IN subtractions: IN municipal bond interest, state income taxes, state NOL, etc.

field.name: state_credits
field.comment: IN tax credits: economic development, R&D, headquarters relocation, neighborhood assistance, etc.
